# Barro Industries

> Barro Industries OPC, well known as Barro Kitchens, designs, fabricates, delivers and installs premium stainless-steel commercial kitchens and equipment, built to order, from its base in Quezon City, Metro Manila, Philippines. The business has been running for 23 years and began as a family business in Baguio City and La Union.

Barro Industries builds kitchens for restaurants, cafés, hotels, hospitals, schools and laboratories, commissary kitchens, government institutions and homes. It works end to end: consultation and site visit, design and layout, fabrication, delivery, installation and commissioning, then after-sales support. Every piece is built to your exact dimensions, with seams welded and ground smooth and surfaces polished to a professional finish. "Barro Kitchens" is the long-standing, well-known name of the same business.

Key facts:
- Materials: food-grade SS304 stainless steel as standard; laboratory-grade SS316 on request.
- Construction: made-to-order tables, sinks and stoves have a 1.5 mm (16 gauge) top plate; bodies and shelving 1.2 mm; square-tube posts with adjustable bullet feet.
- Finishes: brushed, mirror or satin.
- Registrations: PhilGEPS-registered, SEC-registered and VAT-registered.
- Warranty: a 6-month service warranty on equipment and work. Full-kitchen projects include 12 months of preventive maintenance service (PMS) with KitchenShield™.
- Prices are not published. The online quote request shows an estimated range for your selection, and the final quotation is sent after review. No account is needed.

## Services
- [Services overview](https://barroindustries.com/services/): the six services and how a project runs
- [Commercial and commissary kitchen fit-outs](https://barroindustries.com/services/commercial-kitchen-fit-out/): design-build from concept to completion, one contractor from drawings to commissioning
- [Stainless-steel and metal fabrication](https://barroindustries.com/services/stainless-steel-fabrication/): work tables, sinks, cabinets, shelving and racks, plus railings, gates, structural and sheet-metal work to your drawing
- [Exhaust and fresh-air systems](https://barroindustries.com/services/exhaust-and-fresh-air-systems/): range hoods, ducting and blowers that remove heat, smoke and grease
- [Fresh-air systems](https://barroindustries.com/services/fresh-air-systems/): supply air that replaces what the exhaust removes
- [LPG gas line installation](https://barroindustries.com/services/lpg-gas-line-installation/): a centralised, fully welded gas line from an external tank farm to the cooking line, with leak detection and an emergency shut-off valve
- [Kitchen fire suppression](https://barroindustries.com/services/kitchen-fire-suppression/): wet chemical suppression integrated with the range hood
- [Institutional and government supply](https://barroindustries.com/services/institutional-and-government-supply/): equipment, work tables and sinks supplied and installed for schools, LGUs and government agencies through public bidding

## Products
- [Catalogue](https://barroindustries.com/catalogue/): products in five categories (preparation, washing, cooking, storage, refrigeration), with sizes, notes and specifications, and no prices
- [Stainless-steel equipment](https://barroindustries.com/products/): overview of the six configurable stainless-steel products
- [Stainless-steel sinks](https://barroindustries.com/products/stainless-steel-sinks/): one to four sinks, a gooseneck or pre-rinse spray faucet, made to your size
- [Stainless-steel work tables](https://barroindustries.com/products/stainless-steel-work-tables/): one to three layers and up to two upper shelves, made to your size
- [Commercial gas stoves](https://barroindustries.com/products/commercial-gas-stoves/): up to six burners chosen one by one, with a griller, griddle, oven or fryer added
- [Stainless-steel cabinets](https://barroindustries.com/products/stainless-steel-cabinets/): floor-standing or wall-hung, swing or sliding doors
- [Stainless-steel shelving](https://barroindustries.com/products/stainless-steel-shelving/): one to three tiers, solid or slotted
- [Stainless-steel racks](https://barroindustries.com/products/stainless-steel-racks/): three to six tiers, with or without wheels

## Projects
- [Our work](https://barroindustries.com/work/): completed projects with photographs
- [ISPSC 2026](https://barroindustries.com/work/ispsc-2026/): Ilocos Sur Polytechnic State College, stainless-steel laboratory and kitchen work tables, sinks, gas ranges and exhaust hoods, fabricated and installed in a school room (March 2026)
- [DMMMSU 2022-2023](https://barroindustries.com/work/dmmmsu-2022-2023/): Don Mariano Marcos Memorial State University, stainless-steel equipment delivered and installed on campus in La Union (March 2023 to December 2025)

## Areas served
Based in Quezon City, with completed projects across Luzon, from Ilocos Sur in the north to Batangas in the south: Ilocos Sur, La Union, Baguio, La Trinidad, Tarlac, Pampanga, Bulacan, Iba (Zambales), Subic, Manila, Cavite, Laguna and Batangas.
- [Areas we serve](https://barroindustries.com/areas-we-serve/): the Luzon map and the thirteen locations
